_about: Floey's two approved voices (Sudhan, 2026-10-01: 'both the voices are really great, save both, we will use based on preference'). Pick per reel with FLOEY_ENGINE=kokoro|chatterbox; the default is chatterbox when .venv-cb is installed. Both start from the same voice: af_heart blended 0.82 with af_bella 0.18, lifted about 1.2 semitones.

kokoro.name: Floey (clean)
kokoro.how: blend + pitch lift + presence EQ; each line's emotion sets pitch, pace and the pause after it

chatterbox.name: Floey (acted)
chatterbox.engine: Chatterbox (MIT) with brand/mascot/floey-ref.wav as the voice reference

chatterbox.good_for: story moments, hooks, endings, anything that needs feeling
